caption: The drawing depicts a simple architectural structure resembling the facade of a building, rendered in black and white. The structure has a gabled roof and a central doorway framed by columns and a triangular pediment with geometric detailing. There is a set of wide steps leading up to the doorway. Above the doorway, there are two rectangular windows stacked vertically, the upper one being smaller. To the left, an adjoining wall features two window openings. The shading indicates some texture and possibly light and shadow effects on the building’s surface. Below the building, a ribbon-shaped banner contains the inscription "1797 Mission San Jose", written in a neat, cursive style. The background of the image is plain and uncolored, emphasizing the architectural features and text.
title: Mision San Jose
